name: credentials-github-app
description: The `github-app` git auth STRATEGY, moved out of the core: it turns a GitHub App private key resolved through `credentials@1` into a short-lived installation access token (RS256 JWT + the GitHub REST endpoint, cached in memory) and hands the core the `git -c ...` arguments. Registers NO provider id: the credential VALUE comes from the ordinary providers (`credentials-basic`), this plugin only mints from it.

apiBase.description: GitHub REST API base; default https://api.github.com (a source 'auth.apiBase' wins)

username.description: Basic-auth username; default x-access-token (a source 'auth.username' wins)
